records.title: How My Smart Gravity DCA Model Scales Paycheck Multipliers to Outperform Blind Investing
records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 19 July 2026.

[2026-07-19_GENERIC]  
Video Title: Crypto Market Cycles Decoded  
Video ID: N/A  

Smart Gravity DCA Model (GENERIC) | Class: EQUITY  

Current Market Structure  
The top 20 cryptos are segmented into four primary zones: golden breakout (momentum > median over the last 90 days and risk deep accumulation (low momentum, low risk), euphoria (high momentum, high risk), and value trap (low momentum, high risk). The model tracks 20‑week, 50‑week, and 200‑week SMAs to gauge trend strength, with most assets currently trading near the 20‑week SMA but below the 50‑week SMA, indicating a consolidation phase. Momentum‑risk quadrants place BTC, ETH, and ADA in the deep accumulation zone, while newer tokens hover in the euphoria quadrant. The accumulation profile is characterized by a sharp drop in volatility and a baseline price that lags the 200‑week SMA, suggesting a potential reversal window.  

Quantitative Valuation & Gravity  
A blind DCA of $50 per week would yield an ROI of 42% over the past year, whereas the Smart Gravity approach boosts this to 74‑75%, a 31% increase, by allocating $125 during aggressive crash zones and deferring the remaining $25 to a cash pile that grew from $2,800 to $2,850 in three days. The model uses a rolling two‑year z‑core metric; a z‑core > 1.4 signals a top, prompting the strategy to hold cash until the next crash opportunity. The Efficient Frontier positioning shows an annualized return of 74‑75% against a volatility of 35%, outperforming the blind DCA’s 42% return at 50% volatility.  

Target Floors & Trap Identifications  
The aggressive crash zone is identified when the z‑core exceeds 1.4, marking a panic drawdown floor that the model avoids by allocating cash. Value traps are flagged by low momentum and high risk, while euphoria overextensions are flagged by high momentum and high risk; both are avoided by the Smart Gravity logic. The model sets a standard deviation band of ±2σ around the rolling two‑year mean to detect potential reversals, with a floor at -35% to -25% relative to the baseline, mirroring the 2022 bear market scenario. The strategy explicitly names BTC, ETH, and ADA as current deep accumulation assets, with BTC positioned near a baseline of 20.02 and ETH slightly above, indicating a cautious accumulation window.
